name: Amazon Music Unlimited

fastest.text: Open Your Amazon Music Settings at amazon.com/music/settings and choose Cancel subscription under Subscription Renewal.

steps: Sign in at amazon.com and open Your Amazon Music Settings.
Find the Amazon Music Unlimited section.
Under Subscription Renewal details, select Cancel subscription.
note: Signed up through Google or your mobile carrier? Cancel with them; they also handle refunds.

faq.a: You keep Amazon Music Unlimited until your plan ends. After that, songs and podcasts in your library are greyed out.
Eligible monthly plans bought from Amazon can be paused. Annual plans, free trials, promotions and plans billed by Apple, Google or a carrier can't.
No. Amazon Music Unlimited is a separate subscription; your Prime membership isn't affected.
